title: Check out a GitHub pull request locally
summary: Fetch and switch to the branch associated with a specific pull request. This allows you to test or review the changes locally.
prerequisites: You are in a directory that is a git repository linked to GitHub
You are logged in to GitHub with gh auth login

steps.explain: Fetch the branch for the specified pull request and check it out.

placeholders.name: PR_NUMBER_OR_URL_OR_BRANCH
placeholders.description: The PR number (e.g., 456), the full URL, or the branch name
